info.title: CareerNest API
info.description:
## CareerNest Placement Portal — REST API

Full-stack placement management system built with **NestJS + TypeScript**.

### Authentication
All protected endpoints require an `x-role` header. Set it in **Authorize** (top-right) or per-request:

| Role | Who uses it | Example header |
|---|---|---|
| `candidate` | Students applying for jobs | `x-role: candidate` |
| `recruiter` | Company HR posting opportunities | `x-role: recruiter` |
| `alumni` | Alumni providing referrals | `x-role: alumni` |
| `placement_officer` | Admin managing the platform | `x-role: placement_officer` |

### Demo Flow
1. `GET /opportunities` — view live jobs
2. `POST /applications` — candidate applies
3. `PATCH /applications/{id}/status` — recruiter shortlists
4. `POST /assessments` — recruiter schedules test (auto-notifies applicants)
5. `GET /notifications?candidateId=1` — candidate sees announcement

### Base URL
`http://localhost:3000`
